api_decisions.envelope: Approved OpenAPI success/meta envelope; menus add data array, not the source-request top-level array.

preparation.connection: Existing application SqlSessionFactory; one forced commit or rollback.

preparation.flyway: Versioned resources are Flyway-compatible; automatic Flyway is disabled to honor D5 explicit preparation without mutation of an installation before preflight. Container executes preparation before serving; do not concurrently enable automatic Flyway.
preparation.mismatch: stderr catalog differences and nonzero command exit. No confirmation bypass or schema repair.
preparation.status_code_comments: PROJ_STAT_CD and CLOSE_STAT_CD allowed values are unspecified. No invented status enums/comments or business behavior were added.

ui_contract.shell: Single AppLayout/Header/Sidebar; title/actions/children insertion slots; six disabled tools in their reference regions; no fake user or counts.

ui_contract.style: 56px header, 240/64px sidebar, 280px mobile drawer at <=767px; exact light/dark semantic colors, compact density, internal scrolling, reduced-motion behavior.
ui_contract.integration: Menu controller/service/mapper, graph tests, dynamic placeholder screen wrapper and seed icon registry are present and connected. NavigationRoot.renderScreen remains the body integration seam.
